description: Election Commission - Declare that Mr. W. A. K. Wickramasingha as Chairman and Mr. A. Darmakeerthi as Vice Chairman of the  Ibbagamuwa Pradishiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in the offices of Chairman and Vice Chairman of a local government authority (Ibbagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including the declaration of elected officials to fill positions that became vacant due to previous office holders being elected to Parliament or promoted to Chairman. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as it concerns the electoral process and filling of elected positions in local government bodies.
